scenes.say: Two bad beats in a row, and your brain hands the steering wheel to your ego.
Tilt: emotion takes over. You chase, you bet bigger, you play worse.
Two groups, same skill, win {a_p} of hands. The tilted group triples its bet after two losses, and plays worse.
Your edge didn't disappear because of bad cards. It disappeared when your decisions got worse.
Losing streaks are a signal to stop, not to raise the stakes.

takeaway: Losing streaks are a signal to stop, not to raise the stakes.
